source_locator: Document '08-28-2012 Final Precinct Text File.txt', contest 'MAYOR - CITY OF SCOTTSDALE'. Votes are the citywide total; precinct-level files are summed over all precincts.
verification_note: Maricopa County official results list Jim Lane 21837, John Washington 10161, Drew Bernhardt 7367 under 'MAYOR - CITY OF SCOTTSDALE'. The write-in line took 83 votes. Total mayoral votes 39448; the winner took 55.4 percent. Lane took a majority of the mayoral vote at the primary, so no mayoral contest appeared at the November general election, and the county file for that general confirms this. Scottsdale's candidate handbook states that to be elected at the primary a candidate must receive a majority of all legal votes cast for that race, and that a general election is held to elect any office that remains unfilled after the primary.
